name: Astra Mini S Pro
summary: Astra Mini S Pro is the short-range structured-light module in the Astra Mini Pro series. It supports compact embedded robotics, including bin picking and collaborative-robot interaction, using onboard depth processing and USB 2.0. Its working-distance configuration differs from the longer-range Astra Mini Pro.
